finalProject.prompt: Explain how Babyface shaped R&B through his soft vocal delivery, elite songwriting, and refined production style. Compare ONE of his own songs (‘Whip Appeal’) with ONE classic he wrote for someone else (‘End of the Road,’ ‘Unbreak My Heart,’ or ‘Exhale’) and identify TWO modern artists whose writing or sound reflects Babyface’s influence.
